parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The connection id to connect to a Qdrant instance.

parameters.name: collection_name
parameters.description: The name of the collection to ingest data into.

parameters.name: vectors
parameters.description: An iterable over vectors to upload.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Iterable of vector payloads, Optional. Defaults to None.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Iterable of custom vector ids, Optional. Defaults to None.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Number of points to upload per-request. Defaults to 64.

parameters.name: parallel
parameters.description: Number of parallel upload processes. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Start method for parallel processes. Defaults to 'forkserver'.

parameters.name: max_retries
parameters.description: Number of retries for failed requests. Defaults to 3.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Await for the results to be applied on the server side. Defaults to True.

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The connection id to use when connecting to Qdrant. Defaults to `qdrant_default`.
